name: Hex Architecture Refactoring
description: Refactor forward-mcp to use hex layered architecture with domain, ports, usecases, and adapters

phases.name: Extract Domain Layer
phases.description: Create domain entities with no external dependencies

tasks.title: Extract domain entities
tasks.description: Move NQERunResult, NQEQuery, Network, Device, Snapshot, Location, PathSearch types to domain/entities/models.go
tasks.done_condition: go build ./... passes - no forward package dependency in domain

phases.name: Define Port Interfaces
phases.description: Create interfaces defining how domain interacts with outside world

tasks.title: Create port interfaces
tasks.description: Extract CacheInterface from semantic_cache.go and ClientInterface from forward/client.go to ports/
tasks.done_condition: ports/cache.go and ports/forward.go compile with domain types

phases.name: Move Adapters
phases.description: Move adapter implementations to proper packages

tasks.title: Move Forward API client
tasks.description: Move internal/forward to internal/adapters/forward, update package name

tasks.title: Move semantic cache
tasks.description: Move semantic cache to internal/adapters/cache, update to use ports.CacheInterface
tasks.done_condition: go build ./... passes - semantic_cache compiles with ports

tasks.title: Move NQE database
tasks.description: Move nqe_db.go and nqe_query_index.go to internal/adapters/database

tasks.title: Move memory system
tasks.description: Move memory_system.go and api_memory_tracker.go to internal/adapters/memory

phases.name: Refactor Use Cases
phases.description: Move and refactor MCP service to use port interfaces

tasks.title: Refactor MCP service
tasks.description: Move mcp_service.go to usecases/, refactor to import from ports not adapters
tasks.done_condition: go build ./cmd/... passes - server binary builds

phases.name: Update Entry Points
phases.description: Update CLI and scripts to new package paths

tasks.title: Update cmd/server/main.go
tasks.description: Update import paths in main.go to use new usecases package

phases.name: Validate & Test
phases.description: Run full test suite and validate hex boundaries

tasks.title: Run full test suite
tasks.description: Run go test ./... and hex analyze to validate architecture
tasks.done_condition: go test ./... passes && hex analyze . shows 0 violations
